input_contract.alphabet: protein amino-acid substitutions with MSA features

score_contract.score_semantics: precomputed AlphaMissense variant_pathogenicity for applicable missense variants

provenance.notes: Official repository was audited. The project publishes precomputed predictions for human missense variants and explicitly does not publish trained model weights; non-missense records must remain missing. The current temporal cohort is not yet mapped to an approved transcript/missense subset, so this comparator is deferred by compatibility and subset definition. No predictions were downloaded.
